business_summary: Jimu Group Limited, an investment holding company, trades in footwear, apparel, and sports-related peripheral products in Hong Kong and Canada. It offers formal and casual footwear, and apparel products to wholesalers and retailers. The company was formerly known as Ever Smart International Holdings Limited and changed its name to Jimu Group Limited in February 2018. Jimu Group Limited was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Hong Kong, Hong Kong.
